description:
Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it, Eusocial Engineering, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Eusocial Engineering trigger, creating a 2/2 colorless Robot artifact creature token
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Eusocial Engineering trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
